preferredEditor.title: Preferred Editor
preferredEditor.description: The preferred editor to open files in.

debugKeystrokeLogging.title: Debug Keystroke Logging
debugKeystrokeLogging.description: Enable debug logging of keystrokes to the console.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language for the user interface. Use "auto" to detect from system settings. You can also use custom language codes (e.g., "es", "fr") by placing JS language files in ~/.papert/locales/ (e.g., ~/.papert/locales/es.js).

format.title: Output Format
format.description: The format of the CLI output.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The color theme for the UI.

showStatusInTitle.title: Show Status in Title
showStatusInTitle.description: Show Gemini CLI status and thoughts in the terminal window title

hideTips.title: Hide Tips
hideTips.description: Hide helpful tips in the UI

hideContextSummary.title: Hide Context Summary
hideContextSummary.description: Hide the context summary (GEMINI.md, MCP servers) above the input.

hideCWD.title: Hide CWD
hideCWD.description: Hide the current working directory path in the footer.

hideSandboxStatus.title: Hide Sandbox Status
hideSandboxStatus.description: Hide the sandbox status indicator in the footer.

hideModelInfo.title: Hide Model Info
hideModelInfo.description: Hide the model name and context usage in the footer.

hideFooter.title: Hide Footer
hideFooter.description: Hide the footer from the UI

showMemoryUsage.title: Show Memory Usage
showMemoryUsage.description: Display memory usage information in the UI

showLineNumbers.title: Show Line Numbers
showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers in the chat.

showCitations.title: Show Citations
showCitations.description: Show citations for generated text in the chat.

customWittyPhrases.title: Custom Witty Phrases
customWittyPhrases.description: Custom witty phrases to display during loading.

enableWelcomeBack.title: Enable Welcome Back
enableWelcomeBack.description: Show welcome back dialog when returning to a project with conversation history.

screenReader.title: Screen Reader Mode
screenReader.description: Render output in plain-text to be more screen reader accessible

hasSeenNudge.title: Has Seen IDE Integration Nudge
hasSeenNudge.description: Whether the user has seen the IDE integration nudge.

model.title: Model
model.description: Settings related to the generative model.

name.title: Model
name.description: The Gemini model to use for conversations.

useModelRouter.title: Enable Model Routing
useModelRouter.description: Enable dynamic model routing for auto model selection (e.g., choose between fast and pro models per request).

maxSessionTurns.title: Max Session Turns
maxSessionTurns.description: Maximum number of user/model/tool turns to keep in a session. -1 means unlimited.

sessionTokenLimit.title: Session Token Limit
sessionTokenLimit.description: The maximum number of tokens allowed in a session.

skipLoopDetection.title: Skip Loop Detection
skipLoopDetection.description: Disable all loop detection checks (streaming and LLM).

skipStartupContext.title: Skip Startup Context
skipStartupContext.description: Avoid sending the workspace startup context at the beginning of each session.

openAILoggingDir.title: OpenAI Logging Directory
openAILoggingDir.description: Custom directory path for OpenAI API logs. If not specified, defaults to logs/openai in the current working directory.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed requests.

disableCacheControl.title: Disable Cache Control
disableCacheControl.description: Disable cache control for DashScope providers.

context.title: Context
context.description: Settings for managing context provided to the model.

fileName.title: Context File Name
fileName.description: The name of the context file.

importFormat.title: Memory Import Format
importFormat.description: The format to use when importing memory.

discoveryMaxDirs.title: Memory Discovery Max Dirs
discoveryMaxDirs.description: Maximum number of directories to search for memory.

includeDirectories.title: Include Directories
includeDirectories.description: Additional directories to include in the workspace context. Missing directories will be skipped with a warning.

loadMemoryFromIncludeDirectories.title: Load Memory From Include Directories
loadMemoryFromIncludeDirectories.description: Whether to load memory files from include directories.

disableFuzzySearch.title: Disable Fuzzy Search
disableFuzzySearch.description: Disable fuzzy search when searching for files.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Settings for built-in and custom tools.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: Sandbox execution environment (can be a boolean or a path string).

enableInteractiveShell.title: Enable Interactive Shell
enableInteractiveShell.description: Use node-pty for an interactive shell experience. Fallback to child_process still applies.

pager.title: Pager
pager.description: The pager command to use for shell output. Defaults to `cat`.

autoAccept.title: Auto Accept
autoAccept.description: Automatically accept and execute tool calls that are considered safe (e.g., read-only operations).

allowed.title: Allowed Tools
allowed.description: A list of tool names that will bypass the confirmation dialog.

exclude.title: Exclude Tools
exclude.description: Tool names to exclude from discovery.

approvalMode.title: Approval Mode
approvalMode.description: Approval mode for tool usage. Controls how tools are approved before execution.

discoveryCommand.title: Tool Discovery Command
discoveryCommand.description: Command to run for tool discovery.

callCommand.title: Tool Call Command
callCommand.description: Command to run for tool calls.

useRipgrep.title: Use Ripgrep
useRipgrep.description: Use ripgrep for file content search instead of the fallback implementation. Provides faster search performance.

useBuiltinRipgrep.title: Use Builtin Ripgrep
useBuiltinRipgrep.description: Use the bundled ripgrep binary. When set to false, the system-level "rg" command will be used instead. This setting is only effective when useRipgrep is true.

enableToolOutputTruncation.title: Enable Tool Output Truncation
enableToolOutputTruncation.description: Enable truncation of large tool outputs.

truncateToolOutputThreshold.title: Tool Output Truncation Threshold
truncateToolOutputThreshold.description: Truncate tool output if it is larger than this many characters. Set to -1 to disable.

truncateToolOutputLines.title: Tool Output Truncation Lines
truncateToolOutputLines.description: The number of lines to keep when truncating tool output.

enableHooks.title: Enable Hooks System
enableHooks.description: Enable the hooks system for intercepting and customizing Papert Code behavior. When enabled, hooks configured in settings will execute at appropriate lifecycle events (BeforeTool, AfterTool, BeforeModel, etc.). Requires MessageBus integration.

lsp.title: LSP
lsp.description: Language Server Protocol (LSP) integration settings. Configure servers per language and enable/disable globally.

servers.title: LSP Servers
servers.description: Map of LSP server configurations keyed by server name (e.g. "typescript", "pyright").

command.title: Command
command.description: Command to start the LSP server (e.g. [\"typescript-language-server\", \"--stdio\"]).

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: File extensions handled by this server (e.g. [\".ts\", \".tsx\"]).

env.title: Environment
env.description: Environment variables for the server process.

initialization.title: Initialization Options
initialization.description: Initialization options sent in the LSP initialize request.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: Settings for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

serverCommand.title: MCP Server Command
serverCommand.description: Command to start an MCP server.

allowed.title: Allow MCP Servers
allowed.description: A list of MCP servers to allow.

excluded.title: Exclude MCP Servers
excluded.description: A list of MCP servers to exclude.

useSmartEdit.title: Use Smart Edit
useSmartEdit.description: Enable the smart-edit tool instead of the replace tool.

enabled.title: Folder Trust
enabled.description: Setting to track whether Folder trust is enabled.

enforcedType.title: Enforced Auth Type
enforcedType.description: The required auth type. If this does not match the selected auth type, the user will be prompted to re-authenticate.

useExternal.title: Use External Auth
useExternal.description: Whether to use an external authentication flow.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for OpenAI compatible authentication.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL for OpenAI compatible API.

autoConfigureMemory.title: Auto Configure Max Old Space Size

excludedEnvVars.title: Excluded Project Environment Variables
excludedEnvVars.description: Environment variables to exclude from project context.

allOf.title: Bug Command
allOf.description: Configuration for the bug report command.

tavilyApiKey.title: Tavily API Key (Deprecated)
tavilyApiKey.description: ⚠️ DEPRECATED: Please use webSearch.provider configuration instead. Legacy API key for the Tavily API.

visionModelPreview.title: Vision Model Preview
visionModelPreview.description: Enable vision model support and auto-switching functionality. When disabled, vision models like papert-vl-max-latest will be hidden and auto-switching will not occur.

vlmSwitchMode.title: VLM Switch Mode
vlmSwitchMode.description: Default behavior when images are detected in input. Values: once (one-time switch), session (switch for entire session), persist (continue with current model). If not set, user will be prompted each time. This is a temporary experimental feature.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Hook configurations for intercepting and customizing agent behavior.

disabled.title: Disabled Hooks
disabled.description: List of hook names (commands) that should be disabled. Hooks in this list will not execute even if configured.

allOf.title: Before Tool Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute before tool execution. Can intercept, validate, or modify tool calls.

allOf.title: After Tool Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute after tool execution. Can process results, log outputs, or trigger follow-up actions.

allOf.title: Before Agent Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute before agent loop starts. Can set up context or initialize resources.

allOf.title: After Agent Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute after agent loop completes. Can perform cleanup or summarize results.

allOf.title: Notification Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute on notification events (errors, warnings, info). Can log or alert on specific conditions.

allOf.title: Session Start Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute when a session starts. Can initialize session-specific resources or state.

allOf.title: Session End Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute when a session ends. Can perform cleanup or persist session data.

allOf.title: Pre-Compress Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute before chat history compression. Can back up or analyze conversation before compression.

allOf.title: Before Model Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute before LLM requests. Can modify prompts, inject context, or control model parameters.

allOf.title: After Model Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute after LLM responses. Can process outputs, extract information, or log interactions.

allOf.title: Before Tool Selection Hooks
allOf.description: Hooks that execute before tool selection. Can filter or prioritize available tools dynamically.

additionalProperties.description: Custom hook event arrays that contain hook definitions for user-defined events

workspacesWithMigrationNudge.title: Workspaces with Migration Nudge
workspacesWithMigrationNudge.description: List of workspaces for which the migration nudge has been shown.

MCPServerConfig.description: Definition of a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration.

args.description: Command-line arguments for the stdio transport command.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the server process.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers sent to the server.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for MCP requests.

trust.description: Marks the server as trusted. Trusted servers may gain additional capabilities.

includeTools.description: Subset of tools that should be enabled for this server. When omitted all tools are enabled.

excludeTools.description: Tools that should be disabled for this server even if exposed.

extension.description: Metadata describing the Papert Code extension that owns this MCP server.

oauth.description: OAuth configuration for authenticating with the server.

authProviderType.description: Authentication provider used for acquiring credentials (for example `dynamic_discovery`).

enabled.description: Enable telemetry. When true (default), usage data will be sent to improve the product.

otlpProtocol.description: OTLP protocol for telemetry (grpc or http).

logPrompts.description: Enable or disable logging of user prompts for telemetry.

outfile.description: Redirect telemetry output to the specified file.

useCollector.description: Use the telemetry collector when set by environment or settings.

SummarizeToolOutputSettings.description: Per-tool configuration for summarizing tool output to save tokens.

tokenBudget.description: Maximum tokens to allocate for summarizing a tool output.

contextPercentageThreshold.description: A value between 0 and 1 that specifies the token threshold for compression as a percentage of the model token limit.

url.description: The URL to open when running the /bug command.

repo.description: GitHub repository in the form owner/repo.

labels.description: Default labels to apply to bug reports.

enforcedType.description: Optional enforced authentication type (e.g., for enterprise policy).

additionalProperties.description: Keybinding sequences for a given action.

HookDefinitionArray.description: Array of hook definition objects for a specific event.

items.description: Hook definition specifying matcher pattern and hook configurations.

matcher.description: Pattern to match against the event context (tool name, notification type, etc.). Supports exact match, regex (/pattern/), and wildcards (*).

hooks.description: Hooks to execute when the matcher matches.

command.description: Shell command to execute. Receives JSON input via stdin and returns JSON output via stdout.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for hook execution.
